A strip of the whole shot, one frame every 0.33 s with its time. Written: starts on the windscreen three-shot (all three seated, Jason looking hard at us, gun flat on his chest); the camera swings round to his window as he rises on his knees and leans out of the OPEN window to the waist, turned back; we hang beside him; he fires four shots at the lead police car (each a flash and a kick of the arm); the fourth hits its driver (blood on the glass, he slumps); the police car slews onto the pavement, breaks a hydrant (water jet) and crashes into a shop front (fireball, black smoke); passers-by duck and run; Jason drops back into his seat and the shot ends on the same windscreen frame it began on. His legs are never seen (he kneels on the seat).
